entries.en: Yeah, what is it?
Doran didn't have a clue what I was doing. He assumed I was cheating.
entries.tr: Doran ne yaptığım hakkında hiçbir fikri yoktu. Hile yaptığımı varsaydı.

entries.en: Either you're cheating or you're not.
I was just tipping the scales in my favor. Only as an experiment.
entries.tr: Sadece terazileri lehime çeviriyordum. Yalnızca deney olarak.

entries.en: To you, maybe. But this device is merely intended to simulate situations and record results.
entries.tr: Senin için belki. Ama bu cihaz yalnızca durumları simüle edip sonuçları kaydetmek için.

entries.en: Recording losses is easy, of course. Nobody notices those.
entries.tr: Kayıpları kaydetmek tabii kolay. Kimse fark etmez.

entries.en: Mmh.
Why were you tossed out of there?
Seems the owner didn't like the way you played their games.
entries.tr: Görünüşe göre sahibi oyunlarını oynama biçiminden hoşlanmadı.

entries.en: It still sounds like cheating to me.
Goodbye.
What happened?
You cheated?
Nothing.
Explain.
I'm getting to it.
Here you go. I hope it's what you're looking for.
Actually, I gave your device to Doran.
Not yet.
Yes.
Gave it away.
Of course.
Soon.
It's gone.
Ah, change your mind? Are you going to help me record those wins?
entries.tr: Ah, fikrini mi değiştirdin? O kazançları kaydetmeme yardım edecek misin?

entries.en: You again. What do you want now?
Hey. The system is a big success.
Many thanks.
[sigh] What am I going to do now?
I'm ruined. Ruined!
Excellent indeed. This will provide me with invaluable data.
entries.tr: Gerçekten mükemmel. Bu bana paha biçilmez veri sağlayacak.

entries.en: You enjoy those winnings. I'm going to get this system completed.
entries.tr: O kazançların tadını çıkar. Ben bu sistemi tamamlayacağım.

entries.en: But that was years of work. What am I going to do now?
entries.tr: Ama bu yıllarca emekti. Şimdi ne yapacağım?

entries.en: Maybe you should put your talents to better use.
You're no help at all.
This is absolutely the worst day of my life.
entries.tr: Bu hayatımın kesinlikle en kötü günü.

entries.en: Doran caught me cheating and took it from me.
I lost it.
Doran found out.
Well, don't wait forever.
So, did you record five wins with the device yet?
entries.tr: Peki cihazla beş kazanç kaydettin mi?

entries.en: You were cheating, though, weren't you?
I know Doran. If he says you're cheating, you're cheating.
entries.tr: Doran'ı tanırım. Hile yaptığını söylüyorsa yapıyorsundur.

entries.en: But you were cheating, were you not?
And yet here you are, cheater.
Ah, now you're getting to the heart of it.
I've spent the last five years developing a system that can accurately predict wins and losses on the quasar.
entries.tr: Son beş yılı quasar'da kazanç ve kayıpları doğru tahmin edebilen bir sistem geliştirerek geçirdim.

entries.en: I just need a few more recorded wins and I can complete the algorithms.
entries.tr: Algoritmaları tamamlamak için sadece birkaç kayıtlı kazanç daha lazım.

entries.en: It's illegal to use my system. But I won't use it, I'll sell it to others.
entries.tr: Sistemimi kullanmak yasadışı. Ama ben kullanmayacağım, başkalarına satacağım.

entries.en: Hmm. I suppose I could let you try it.
I just need a few more wins recorded.
entries.tr: Sadece birkaç kazanç daha kaydetmem lazım.

entries.en: Of course, if you get caught with the device, well, you saw what happened to me.
entries.tr: Elbette cihazla yakalanırsan, şey, bana ne olduğunu gördün.

entries.en: Here you go. When you've recorded enough wins, it will let you know.
entries.tr: İşte. Yeterince kazanç kaydettiğinde sana haber verir.

entries.en: Well, off you go. That data won't collect itself.
entries.tr: Hadi git. O veri kendi kendine toplanmaz.

entries.en: Hmph. Suit yourself. Well, I have some calculations to do. Goodbye.
entries.tr: Hmph. Nasıl istersen. Şey, yapacak hesaplarım var. Hoşça kal.

entries.en: Keep your winnings. That should be payment enough, I think.
entries.tr: Kazançlarını sakla. Bence yeterli bir ödeme.

entries.en: The device is set to emit a frequency that will slightly increase your odds.
entries.tr: Cihaz şansını biraz artıracak bir frekans yayacak şekilde ayarlandı.

entries.en: Nothing like my system eventually will, but enough to allow you to record your wins more quickly.
entries.tr: Sistemimin sonunda yapacağına hiç benzemiyor ama kazançlarını daha hızlı kaydetmene yetecek.

entries.en: What? No. This device is archaic. It uses brute force to achieve its goal. Besides, you saw how easily it was detected.
entries.tr: Ne? Hayır. Bu cihaz ilkel. Amacına ulaşmak için kaba kuvvet kullanıyor. Üstelik ne kadar kolay tespit edildiğini gördün.

entries.en: My system, when it's complete, will be far more efficient and completely undetectable.
entries.tr: Sistemim tamamlandığında çok daha verimli ve tamamen tespit edilemez olacak.

entries.en: Maybe you should put your talents to better use.
Get a job.
You could put your talents to better use.
You are smart. Apply yourself.
Why do you need to record these outcomes?
Can you do that? Isn't that illegal?
entries.tr: Bunu yapabilir misin? Bu yasadışı değil mi?

entries.en: Maybe I could get you the proof you need.
entries.tr: Belki sana ihtiyacın olan kanıtı getirebilirim.

entries.en: I'll help you out.
I think I'll take my chances, the old-fashioned way.
What's in this for me?
Does the device help me win?
Why don't you just sell the device, then?
Maybe not.
Experiment?
So why do it?
Just play the game.
How will that work?
Interesting.
Let me do it.
I won't help you cheat.
Payment
Device
Just sell it as is.
No.
No.
No.
You bet.
Isn't that still cheating?
entries.tr: Bu yine de hile değil mi?
